chunks: As for the right of fasting,
is that you know it is a veil which God has set up over your tongue, your hearing, your sight, your private part, and your stomach to protect you from the Fire.
If you abandon the fast, you will have torn God's protective covering away from yourself.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual significance of fasting as a protective veil in Shia tradition?
ai.summary: Imam Zayn al-Abidin characterizes fasting not merely as abstention from food, but as a comprehensive spiritual shield (hijab) guarding the five primary senses and organs to preserve the believer from the Hellfire. This metaphor emphasizes that neglecting the fast ruptures this divine protection, exposing the soul to spiritual vulnerability. The concept aligns with the Shia understanding of fasting as a means of cultivating inner awareness (taqwa) through sensory discipline.
